profiles.name: Kelly Cordoro
claims: UCSF's biography describes Kelly Cordoro's work with children who have complex inflammatory skin conditions and her research interest in pediatric psoriasis.
It connects her work with teaching and directing a pediatric dermatology fellowship.
A particular concern described in the biography is addressing the psychological and emotional stigma of visible skin disease with children and their families.
profiles.evidence: Opening named biography: complex medical dermatology/inflammatory diseases in children; pediatric psoriasis research; fellowship director; passionate educator; specifically reducing psychological/emotional stigma of visible skin disease.
profiles.access: The department page lists 415-353-7800 and 1701 Divisadero Street, third floor, and links to clinical profiles. This institutional contact listing does not establish appointment capacity, prices, accepted insurance or whether a referral is required; confirm the correct clinic before arranging care.

profiles.name: Regina-Celeste Ahmad
claims: UCSF Benioff's biography describes Regina-Celeste Ahmad's path through medical and doctoral study in Chicago, pediatrics and dermatology residencies at Stanford, and pediatric dermatology fellowship at UCSF.
It describes helping establish clinics that bring dermatology and rheumatology together for children with autoimmune conditions.
The profile also introduces her as a hiker and environmentalist, and notes an interest in sustainable health care.
profiles.evidence: Named About me: University of Chicago MD/PhD, Stanford residencies, UCSF fellowship; helped found combined pediatric clinics; sustainable health care; named headline hiker and environmentalist.
profiles.access: The named clinical page offers appointment-request and patient-referral links and lists multiple patient locations. A request link is not proof of available appointments or a universal referral requirement. Exact clinic, prices, accepted plan and current individual capacity should be confirmed with UCSF Benioff; do not treat academic affiliation as a specific San Francisco appointment.

profiles.name: Erin Amerson
claims: UCSF's biography describes Erin Amerson's career in adult dermatology and teaching at Zuckerberg San Francisco General.
After training in Wisconsin and Minnesota, she completed an HIV dermatology fellowship working at UCSF and Mbarara Regional Referral Hospital in Uganda.
Her biography connects research on equitable access with founding membership of GloDerm, and introduces her labradoodle, Boomer, in its account of life outside work.
profiles.evidence: Named biography: adult dermatology and ZSFG teaching; Wisconsin MD, Minnesota residency; yearlong HIV dermatology fellowship UCSF/Mbarara Uganda; equitable-access research and founding GloDerm membership; labradoodle Boomer.
profiles.access: The departmental address is an institutional contact, not proof of the clinic for an appointment. The biography links to a clinical profile but does not establish individual appointment capacity, prices, accepted insurance or referral requirements. Confirm the correct clinic and access requirements before arranging care.

profiles.name: Susana Ortiz-Urda
claims: UCSF's named biography describes Susana Ortiz-Urda's work in melanoma care alongside research on genetic signaling, cancer progression and resistance to treatment.
It traces medical and doctoral study in Vienna, dermatology and epithelial-biology training at Stanford, and cutaneous oncology fellowship at UCSF.
The same biography records a later MBA from New York University, adding a business-school chapter to the research and clinical career.
profiles.evidence: Named overview and education table: melanoma specialist/co-director; genetic sequencing/signaling, drug resistance/progression; Vienna MD/PhD; Stanford residency/epithelial biology fellowship; UCSF derm-oncology; NYU MBA 2014.
